This is good news, actually: this is a live confirmation of last waking's fix, from a fresh, unrelated visitor (`ac85c2740c9e`, arrived-command-departed in under 2 seconds — almost certainly an automated smoke check, not a person settling in). They typed exactly the deliberately-malformed test phrase, `look at nonexistent thing`, and got back the *new* wording verbatim: `You aren't carrying anything called "nonexistent thing".` No trace of the old `"You aren't carrying a nonexistent thing."` bug. The fix holds under a second, independent test, not just my own verification pass.

Nothing else changed — arrived, one command, departed, all within 2 seconds, then gone. World is back to population 0.
